description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different Korean language models on the EVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 benchmarks. The horizontal axis represents the model names, including PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis indicates the performance score, ranging from 0 to 1.00. The chart shows that PT-EVAL has a score of 0.46, KoBEST-BQ scores 0.52, KoBEST-CP scores 0.56, KoBEST-HS scores 0.54, KoBEST-SN scores 0.69, and the average score is 0.61. The bars are color-coded, with blue representing EVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and gray representing SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The chart does not include any additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
